mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_product (promotion_id, product_id, product_name, product_price, promotion_price, stock, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES (#{promotionId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productPrice}, #{promotionPrice}, #{stock}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM promotion_product WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
